title: Fingerspelling: the two-handed alphabet
summary: All 26 letters, the vowel trick, and spelling your own name.

title: Greetings & introductions
summary: Hello, how are you, my name is…, nice to meet you, and telling people you're learning Auslan.

title: Numbers 0–19
summary: Count from 0 to 19, the thumb trick for 6–9, ages and phone numbers.

title: Questions & facial expression
summary: WHO, WHERE, WHEN, WHY, HOW, WHICH, HOW-MANY, YES and NO, plus the two question faces.

title: Communication strategies
summary: AGAIN, SLOW, UNDERSTAND, SORRY, PLEASE, WAIT, FINGERSPELL: how to keep a conversation going when you're lost.

title: ★ Review: meeting someone new
summary: Put Unit 1 together: a full first-meeting conversation, plus FRIEND, FROM, SAME, ALSO and MAYBE.

title: Family
summary: MOTHER, FATHER, SISTER, BROTHER, HUSBAND/WIFE, CHILD, GRANDPARENTS, and HAVE.

title: Feelings & emotions
summary: HAPPY, SAD, TIRED, ANGRY, EXCITED, WORRIED, SICK, BORED, SCARED, LOVE, plus VERY and how the face shows intensity.

title: Describing people & colours
summary: TALL, SHORT, HAIR, GLASSES, BEARD, OLD, YOUNG and 12 colours, with lots of regional versions.

title: Big numbers, money & birthdays
summary: HUNDRED, THOUSAND, DOLLAR, MONEY, HOW-MUCH, BUY, YEAR and BIRTHDAY (five regional versions!).

title: Pronouns & signing space
summary: HE/SHE, WE, THEY, OUR, THEIR, BOTH, ALL, EVERYONE, and using the space around you to keep track of people.

title: ★ Review: my family & friends
summary: Put Unit 2 together: introduce your family using signing space, plus LIVE, MARRIED, AUNT, UNCLE, COUSIN, DOG and CAT.

title: Time words & time-first order
summary: TODAY, TOMORROW, YESTERDAY, BEFORE, AFTER, LATER, SOON, FINISH, and why time goes first in an Auslan sentence.

title: Days of the week & clock time
summary: Monday to Sunday, WEEK, WEEKEND, TIME, HOUR, MINUTE, and asking what time something is.

title: Daily routine
summary: SHOWER, EAT, DRINK, WORK, GO, COME, HOME, SLEEP, BREAKFAST, LUNCH, DINNER, AFTERNOON and NIGHT.

title: Food & drink
summary: COFFEE, TEA, WATER, BREAD, MEAT, FRUIT, MILK, HUNGRY, THIRSTY, LIKE, WANT and ordering at a café.

title: Negation: not, never, can't
summary: NOT, NO-THANKS, NOTHING, NEVER, CAN and CAN'T, plus the headshake that makes any sentence negative.

title: ★ Review: my day and my week
summary: Put Unit 3 together: describe your day and your week, make plans, and say what you do and don't do. Plus BUSY, FREE, HOLIDAY and PLAN.

title: Places around town
summary: SHOP, SCHOOL, HOSPITAL, BEACH, CITY, HOUSE, TOILET, LIBRARY, CHURCH and LIVE WHERE?

title: Transport & directions
summary: CAR, BUS, TRAIN, BIKE, PLANE, WALK, DRIVE, LEFT, RIGHT, STRAIGHT, NEAR, FAR, and giving directions in space.

title: Weather & seasons
summary: WEATHER, HOT, COLD, RAIN, SUN, WIND, STORM, CLOUD and the four seasons.

title: Hobbies & sport
summary: SPORT, SWIM, FOOTBALL, CRICKET, READ, MOVIE, MUSIC, COOK, TRAVEL, PLAY, GAME, FAVOURITE and PREFER.

title: Work & study
summary: STUDY, STUDENT, TEACHER, DOCTOR, OFFICE, BOSS, INTERPRETER, UNIVERSITY, COMPUTER and asking about jobs.

title: ★ Review: making plans with a friend
summary: Put Unit 4 together: plan an outing (when, where, how to get there, what to do), plus TOGETHER, READY, LATE, EARLY, INVITE and FUN.

title: Directional verbs
summary: GIVE, ASK, TELL, HELP, SHOW, PAY, SEND and TEXT: verbs whose movement shows who does what to whom.

title: Depicting signs 1: people & vehicles
summary: Handshapes that stand for people and vehicles, moved through space to show paths, passing, following and crashing.

title: Depicting signs 2: size & shape
summary: BIG, SMALL, LONG, THIN, WIDE, SQUARE, BALL, BOX, TABLE and ROOM: tracing and shaping objects in space.

title: Role shift: becoming the character
summary: LOOK, SEE, THINK, SURPRISED, SHOCKED, LAUGH, CRY, SHOUT, REPLY, and shifting your body to become different people in a story.

title: Deaf culture & community
summary: DEAF-CLUB, COMMUNITY, CULTURE, HISTORY and HEARING-AID, plus Deaf identity, Auslan's history, technology and etiquette for hearing learners.

title: ★ Final review: tell a story
summary: STORY, HAPPEN, FIRST, THEN, FINALLY and REMEMBER: tell a short story using everything from the course.
